thesis: Price the unpriced axis values (count angle, demo format, interest_niche) before any refinement

Named-customer story creative is the matched-cell signup leader in every era — make story the lead angle
Broad cells produce signups at ~half the cost of interest cells in every era — shift budget share to broad
Demo footage inside the story drives purchases — all 5 settled buys are demo ads, plain holds zero
Purchases concentrate in broad sales cells (5 of 7, best per-dollar) — tilt composition toward sales-broad
All nine purchases sit in broad direct-response cells (sales-broad, leads-broad) — raise their combined share
Persona fatigue replicated (Marcus then Ana decayed on rerun) — keep a fresh persona in every batch
